    Physicochemical protein features

    Source: R/recipes-steps.R
    step_bio_aa_props.Rd

    step_bio_aa_props() creates a specification of a recipe step that replaces a column of protein sequences with the physicochemical properties computed by bio_aa_props(): length, molecular weight, isoelectric point, charge at pH 7, GRAVY hydropathy, aromaticity and the fractions of acidic, basic and hydrophobic residues.

    Usage

    step_bio_aa_props(
  recipe,
  ...,
  role = "predictor",
  trained = FALSE,
  properties = aa_prop_names,
  columns = NULL,
  keep_original_cols = FALSE,
  skip = FALSE,
  id = recipes::rand_id("bio_aa_props")
)

# S3 method for class 'step_bio_aa_props'
tidy(x, ...)

    Arguments

    recipe

    A recipe object. The step is added to its sequence of operations.

    ...

    One or more selector functions to choose sequence columns. See recipes::selections().

    role

    Role for the new feature columns.

    trained

    A logical showing whether the step has been trained.

    properties

    Which properties to keep. Defaults to all nine.

    columns

    The selected columns. Filled in by recipes::prep().

    keep_original_cols

    Keep the original sequence columns?

    skip

    Should the step be skipped when the recipe is baked by recipes::bake()?

    id

    A character string that is unique to this step.

    x

    A step_bio_aa_props object.

    Value

    An updated version of recipe with the new step added. When you tidy() this step, a tibble with columns terms and property is returned.

    See also

    Other tidybiotek recipe steps: step_bio_kmers(), step_bio_vst_norm()

    Examples

    rec <- recipes::recipe(class ~ protein, data = ecoli_cds) |>
  step_bio_aa_props(protein) |>
  recipes::prep()
recipes::bake(rec, new_data = NULL)
